$Comment: Supper for Bram, one of the three supper deliveries that close Martha's questline (Supper_Tomas.json
explains the three). The _Harvest_Feast folder makes the id harvest_feast_supper_bram. Martha gives
it; its one step, cooked wildmeat, is handed in at Bram (TurnInNpcId his role, which his placement
NpcPlacements/Harvest_Feast_Shepherd_Temple.json stands under and keeps standing), whose conversation
opens on his thanks while the player carries it, and plays again once the pay is collected
(CompletionDialogue). Repeat.PerRun brings it back once each year's feast, like The Feast.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Crafting XP, as the cooking quests pay, waiting to be collected
with the rest. The row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server
without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Supper_Bram
